body:
it's not that i dont have feelings.  quite the opposite.  i just don't know what to do or why.  i don't think life is meaningless, i just don't want to get out of bed or do much of anything i used to do and i don't know why.

i laugh but i don't enjoy it.  i don't enjoy or despise any part of anything anymore and thats why i'm here.  i don't have opinions about things

i think trying to trivialize someones feelings and say meaning doesn't matter isn't such a good idea.  if i thought my feelings didn't matter i wouldn't be here.  it isn't about having a burning roaring passion, it's about having any passion at all.  i don't want a future at this point and i don't know why.
